description:
Track purchase costs, expenses, and profit/loss for your vehicles

CarBudget is a desktop app for tracking car purchase costs, running expenses, and calculating profit or loss when selling vehicles. Features include expense logging with photo attachments, plate lookup, currency support, an economy dashboard, and mobile-accessible web UI.
**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/niklas2233/car-budget-tracker/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4
